newsitem.title: USA: Longhorn Steaks acquires Bugaboo Creek.
newsitem.headline: Longhorn Steaks acquires Bugaboo Creek.

text.p: Longhorn Steaks Inc said on Friday that it completed a stock swap acquisition of Bugaboo Creek Steak House Inc.
As previously announced, Longhorn is issuing 2,939,062 of its common shares to the shareholders of Bugaboo, the company said.
Bugaboo shareholders received 0.5625 shares of Longhorn common stock for each share of Bugaboo common stock outstanding, Longhorn said. The merger will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

Also, Longhorn said it acquired three other restaurants and certain related real estate for 240,410 shares of Longhorn common stock. Longhorn Steaks shares gained 1-3/4 to close at 19-3/4 on 187,200 shares of volume.
